title: Report page 1 rebuilt to the design contract change of 2026-10-11 (results with their assumptions, one site graphic, the legal ceiling beside the apartment estimate with the distinction line, at most three linked uncertainties) and the print type scale from the tokens; NB-01 revision 4
objective: Rebuild report page 1 (services/api/app/drawings/report/) to the design contract change of 2026-10-11, rows 1 and furniture: (1) the results in large type, each with its assumption line (R055: '10,075 sq ft recorded lot area x FAR 2.0, tax lot 70 alone') and the allowance phrase beside the headline; (2) one site graphic, the existing compact frame in its unchanged wrapper; (3) 'Legal ceiling 29 (Conditional)' side by side with 'Estimate 17-22 (Provisional)' with the distinction line from the tokens; the estimate links to its full calculation on the scenario sheet; (4) at most three uncertainties in the order zoning lot, lot-area basis, rear yard, each linked to '#issue-<n>'. The coverage inventory leaves the report (coverage_groups stays for the owner update); the scope line goes on page 1 and the material-exclusions block heads the appendix's open items. The generic zoning-lot line (page_decision_summary.py:32-33) and the 'R6B height limits' literal (:88-90) come from data. Print sizes come from the TYPE tokens (layout.py:58-80 hard-coded today; section title print 14 pt). The duplicate long apartment-estimate sentence on the scenario sheet goes (R013). Refactors for later tasks: the zoning-lot logic of readers.py (marker :269, zoning_lot_basis :430-461, its effect line and item builder) moves to a new zoning_lot_item.py (the G-6 report-side isolation); the constraint effect texts (readers.py:270-281) move to a new constraint_text.py that reads the document's own value state; every moved text keeps its 1.4.0 output except the rear-yard text, which becomes the open check of the contract (names 23-344(b) and (c)(3), no conclusion, links 23-344). A presentation-tokens.json wording group holds the distinction line, the two zone labels and the caption, each equal to the contract's quoted text. The stale page-2 CSS comment (layout.py:120-123) is reworded to the one-locator composition. The lot_area effect text names the GIS outline 'city map outline', never 'tax-map outline'. NB-01 revision 4 records the code identity (including M5-T162's readers.py change) and the isolation decision. Wave 24's owner of NB-01.
business_reason: D-094 R073/R078/R081 (the reviewer's next-pass item 1): page 1 must lead with the answers, their assumptions, one site graphic and the few uncertainties that change the answer; the 29 and the 17-22 belong together with a short distinction. This is the first PDF the owner was promised.
